concept.title: Mobility equipment and community transport
concept.shortdesc: Equipment that helps disabled people with mobility and daily living, and transport services that help people get to appointments and activities.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Getting, trying, hiring or adapting equipment, aids and clothing that help disabled people with mobility, sensory needs and daily living.
: Getting transport such as dial-a-ride, shuttle buses, minibuses or volunteer car rides to appointments, social events and other places.
